entities.name: PMID:25072223
observations: Healthy-volunteer crossover study tested oral or IV methadone with or without cyclosporine, a P-glycoprotein inhibitor; cyclosporine had no effect on miosis or R-methadone concentration–miosis relationships, and no effect on measured thermal analgesia.
Cyclosporine marginally decreased methadone plasma concentrations and apparent oral clearance, without changing renal clearance or hepatic N-demethylation.

entities.name: No PD effect of cyclosporine
observations: In healthy volunteers, cyclosporine-inhibitable cerebral transport did not measurably alter methadone miosis or thermal analgesia; the conclusion applies to tested doses, subjects, and endpoints.
